what: smoke run of the 1.5B config (500 train / 100 val examples, 1 epoch, 32 optimizer steps) before and after the 6 GB memory fixes
source: console output of scripts/train.py --smoke runs on 2026-10-17 (the pre-fix summary file was overwritten by the post-fix rerun; values copied from the run output)
gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU, 6.44 GB physical (torch.cuda.mem_get_info), Windows WDDM driver

before.setup: prepare_model_for_kbit_training (fp32 embeddings), full-sequence logits, micro-batch 16, AdamW, HF generate(output_scores) for val
before.note: peak allocation above physical VRAM is only possible through the WDDM system-memory fallback

after.setup: tail-only logits (logits_to_keep), gradient checkpointing, paged 8-bit AdamW, micro-batch 8 x accum 2, allocator capped at 5.4 GB, KV-cache greedy eval
